definitions.mechanical: Native World prefix rebuilt independently per arm, exact selected joint versus removal, six frozen-command steps. First held step matches native; later bond/controller updates, acquisitions and queued strikes omitted from BOTH arms. Censored mechanical slices, not play outcomes or physical realism certification.
definitions.lab: Reduced native-prefix approach forks, starting 0.45 s before first native loaded boundary or first post-catch tick, whichever is later. Same actual runner/first loaded defender, native support, velocities, eyes, histories and capabilities. All bystanders parked and block joints removed. Helper is the named actual athlete deliberately repositioned to a viable opposite lane; NOT original coverage formation. Carrier center y=6/26.67/47.33, x=45; positions/history/support anchors translated together. Original stream versus independent post-prefix execution stream 9001. Native runner versus bends requested after 0.6 s. Ten-second live endpoints censored; no forced whistle, force scaling or solver experiment.
definitions.cutback: A declared bend after 0.6 s is conceded when the original catcher subsequently advances >=5 x yards and >=2 y yards in its requested direction before possession ends. Achieved lateral reversal is separate; controls ending before the bend are unissued, never forced cutbacks.
definitions.identity: Original catcher and selected first loaded tackler preserved. Helpers explicitly identified; reduced lab helper deliberately repositioned, full-native helper probe never repositions anyone.
definitions.turnovers: Catch gains stop at the original catch segment. Defensive return touchdowns and out-of-bounds endings are separate.
definitions.fresh: Two roster cohorts; original and fresh-9001 post-prefix execution streams; new field/helper/runner arms. No new random native-game population or NFL frequency estimate.
definitions.excluded: CB helper prototype and untranslated-progress labs are retained only as discarded harness outputs, not pooled. October 11 review historical; awareness, prolonged holds and ground holds parked.
